extracted.summary: Post-Matric Scholarship for General, Minorities, SC, ST and OBC, Uttar Pradesh is a state‑level scholarship for students in Uttar Pradesh pursuing studies from class 11 to postgraduate level, with income limits varying by category.
extracted.amount_text: Day Scholar and Hosteler amounts vary by category and group from 1 to 4. Hostelers receive up to INR 13,500 per year. Day scholars receive up to INR 7,000 per year.
extracted.categories_quote: Applicants must belong to one of the following categories: General, Scheduled Caste (SC), Scheduled Tribe (ST), Other Backward Classes (OBC), Minorities.
extracted.course_levels_quote: Applicants must be pursuing studies from class 11 to the postgraduate level in recognised institutions.
extracted.states_quote: Applicants must be a resident of Uttar Pradesh.
extracted.deadline_quote: 30 October 2025 for Classes 11 and 12. 20 December 2025 for all except classes 11 and 12.
